value.0: Fen read the cipher? Broken triangle means cache handoff. That fits. Small field hide, old Mandalorian habit, not their main facility.
Then this signet is yours. It came from the cache record, and it is too distinctive to put back into circulation by accident.
Fen Dral can tell patrol marks from route marks. Bring him the cipher plate, then bring his notes back to me.
Keep that signet quiet. It has no lock to open, but it tells a story some Mandalorians may not enjoy hearing.
Jorren Kade studies a bent metal plate scratched with Mandalorian field marks, his thumb resting beside a broken triangle cut into the edge.
This is not a new facility lead. Tal'gar already has that mess. This looks like a minor field cache, but I need Fen's route notes to know whether the marks point to supplies or just a patrol habit.
Take the plate to Fen in the cantina. If he confirms the cache mark, bring his notes back and I will give you the only thing from the record worth keeping.
Jorren Kade gives you a measuring look, then turns back to a stack of marked trail reports. Not yet.
Here are Fen's decoded notes.
Not yet.

I will ask Fen.

What kind of cache?
I will ask Fen to read it.

I will pass for now.
